reviews.body: Found one P2 test-coverage gap in the new invoice search endpoint. All 9 tests and TypeScript typechecking pass.

comments.body:
🟡 **P2** · 🐛 **Bug**

The new tests only exercise `containsPattern`; none calls `GET /invoices` or checks the SQL filtering and count. Removing the search predicate or omitting it from the count query would still leave every test passing. Add endpoint tests against Postgres covering case-insensitive matches on both fields, literal `%`/`_`/backslashes, combinations with `status` and `customer_id`, and matching `total` across pages (including no matches and omitted `q`).
